articles.title: Iran submits new proposal, says U.S. open to sanctions relief
articles.summary: Iran established the Persian Gulf Strait Authority to control maritime traffic. All ships transiting the Strait must receive confirmation from the PSGA. This new body aims to manage passage through the strategic waterway. On May 17, Iran unveiled a new body, the Persian Gulf Strait Authority (PSGA), to control the Strait; according to the new mechanism, all ships seeking to transit the Strait should get a confirmation message, about “ruled and regulations” from the PGSA.

articles.title: Clock is ticking for Iran, says Trump | Above the Fold | 18.05.2026

articles.title: Belgian ex-diplomat dies before standing trial over 1961 murder of Congolese leader
articles.summary: Étienne Davignon, a 93-year-old former Belgian diplomat, died before facing trial. He was charged in the 1961 assassination of Patrice Lumumba, the first Prime Minister of the Democratic Republic of Congo.

articles.title: Cuba warns US of ‘bloodbath’ if military action follows drone claims
articles.summary: Cuban President Miguel Díaz-Canel warned of a "bloodbath" if the U. S. takes military action. This statement follows reports of over 300 drones. articles.title: No Ebola Case In India, Airports Put On Alert After WHO Warning
articles.summary: India has reviewed airport screening and surveillance protocols. This action follows a World Health Organization warning regarding Ebola. articles.title: लखनऊ रेज़ीडेंसी की लड़ाई: भारतीयों की जीत के बावजूद हार की कहानी
articles.summary: 1857 के विद्रोह के दौरान, भारतीय सैनिकों ने लखनऊ रेज़ीडेंसी पर कब्जा कर लिया था। हालांकि, वे इस नियंत्रण को बनाए नहीं रख सके। अंग्रेज अंततः रेज़ीडेंसी से भागने में सफल रहे। अंग्रेज़ 22 नवंबर 1857 को रेज़ीडेंसी छोड़कर भाग निकलने में सफल हो गए और कुछ समय के लिए अवध पर भारतीयों का नियंत्रण रहा.
